records.label: Home
records.explains: Follow the next step, review setup and attention items, and share joining links.
records.when: Check what needs attention during the event.
effects: In the walkthrough, Next and Back move between steps; Skip or Done finishes it.

records.label: Your next step
records.explains: Stage-based guidance and optional checklist acknowledgements; marking an item not needed neither changes its setting nor enforces a prerequisite.
effects: Not needed dismisses an optional item; Use this item restores it. Neither changes the underlying setting.

records.label: Snapshot
records.explains: Counts participants, teams, judges and people without teams, distinguishing organiser judges from dedicated judges.

records.label: Event page
records.explains: Edit the built-in public event page and manage a custom website.
records.when: Prepare or update your public page.

records.label: Settings
records.explains: Configure joining, teams, entries, judging, results and administration.
records.when: Set up or revise your event.

records.label: Change stage
records.explains: Move stages explicitly, including backwards before Ended. Dates and prompts never move stages automatically.
records.when: Open joining, start work, close entries or correct a premature stage change.

options.label: Not open yet
options.means: Draft: set up before participant joining opens.

options.label: Sign-up open
options.means: Open: participants can join and form teams.

options.label: Building
options.means: Participants build and can join or change teams.

options.label: Entries closed
options.means: General entries close; future team extensions survive. Set up judging now; judges can't score yet.

options.label: Judging
options.means: All teams stop editing, including extended teams. Judges can score if unlocked. Mode, judges per team, rubric and assignments lock; Automatic assigns judges now. Back to Entries closed pauses scoring and unlocks setup.

options.label: Results
options.means: Stops scoring and locks judging; does not itself publish a results snapshot.

effects: Entering Open/Building from outside those stages clears passed deadlines and reopens settled drafts; submitted entries stay submitted. Moving between Open and Building does neither.
Returning from Results to Judging keeps the lock; unlock separately with a reason.

records.label: End event
records.explains: Permanently end the event. It cannot be reopened.
records.when: Finish an event people have joined.
effects: At least one approved participant must exist; delete an unused event instead.

The public record and results remain. Team sites are removed after the number of days in CURRENT SETTINGS (30 by default); events can be exempted by the platform. Entries and scoring freeze; nobody can leave an Ended event.

After End, title, tagline, About, Rules, Prizes, conduct, time zone, dates, page style, colour, organiser details, gallery and directory listing remain editable. An AI app connected to Simple Hack can still change team finding, team size and Judging closes, even though the screens disable them. Unlocking, rubric edits and entry exclusion remain possible; scoring stays closed. Results can be republished.

records.label: Basics
records.explains: Set the public title and tagline. The tagline is also used in link previews.
records.when: Name your event or correct its details.

records.label: Starts
records.explains: Set event start and optional end dates and times. End cannot precede start.
records.when: Set or correct the advertised dates.
effects: Dates supply schedule rows and prompts, not automatic stage changes. A date-only end includes the whole day in the event time zone.

records.label: Time zone
records.explains: Choose the zone used to enter and display event dates, deadlines and schedule times.
records.when: Match your event’s local time.
effects: Changing the zone keeps deadline instants. Existing event start and end times keep their local calendar date and wall-clock time in the new zone.
limits: Use a valid IANA time zone, such as Europe/London.

records.label: About
records.explains: Describe the event on its public page. Blank lines separate paragraphs.
records.when: Explain the event to visitors.

records.label: Prizes
records.explains: Describe prizes on the public page.
records.when: Tell teams what they can win.

records.label: Rules
records.explains: Publish event-specific rules.
records.when: Tell teams how your competition works.

records.label: Code of conduct
records.explains: Your additions appear after the standard code when people join. They supplement the standard code.
records.when: Set conduct expectations for joining.

records.label: Schedule
records.explains: Add, edit or remove public schedule items. Fixed event dates and deadlines come from their settings and must be changed there.
records.when: Plan or revise sessions before End.

options.label: Open sign-up
options.means: Ask the organiser to open joining.

options.label: Finish judging
options.means: Ask to move to Results and lock judging.

options.label: Publish results
options.means: Ask to publish a results snapshot.

effects: When this starts, ask to only prompts the organiser. No transition occurs without their action. Content lists cannot change after End.
limits: Up to 100 items. Title: 1–120 characters. Details: up to 500. End must be after start.

records.label: Tracks
records.explains: Optional challenges with a Track name, Challenge and Prize. Each team chooses one track; without tracks everyone competes together.
records.when: Offer separate challenges before End.
effects: Removing a track clears its teams’ selections. Changes stop after End. All tracks use the same event-wide rubric; Panel changes judge access, not criteria.
limits: Up to 12 tracks; field limits are explained separately.

records.label: Sponsors
records.explains: Add sponsor Logo, Name, Tier and Link; drag or use Move up/down to order them publicly.
records.when: Credit event supporters before End.
effects: Remove deletes the sponsor from the list. List editing stops after End.

records.label: FAQ
records.explains: Add public Questions and Answers. Answers start folded; drag or use the menu to reorder.
records.when: Answer common visitor questions before End.
effects: Remove deletes that question. List editing stops after End.
limits: Up to 30 questions. Question: 1–200 characters. Answer: 1–2,000.

records.label: Look
records.explains: Choose the built-in public page appearance. Style and colour changes save immediately.
records.when: Match the page to your event.

records.label: Page style
records.explains: Choose the visual style of the built-in event page. Your colour still drives buttons and links in every style, and content is kept when switching.
records.when: Match the look to your audience.

options.label: Classic
options.means: Today's look: the standard event page.

effects: Try another picks another page style. Changes save immediately.

records.label: Colour
records.explains: Choose the event accent colour. Automatic uses a stable colour based on the event address.
records.when: Use your event’s colours.

options.label: Automatic
options.means: Choose a stable colour from the event address.

records.label: Event icon
records.explains: Upload, replace or remove the event icon. Without an uploaded icon the event has a generated fallback.
records.when: Add your event image before End.
effects: Icon changes stop after End.
limits: PNG, JPEG or WebP; upload size is limited by the server’s event icon allowance.

records.label: Show entries on the event page
records.explains: Control whether visitors can browse the public entry gallery.
records.when: Share entries, including after End.
effects: People’s choice requires the gallery to be open. This does not exclude entries from judging.
The public gallery lists live team websites. The switch stays editable after End.

records.label: Website
records.explains: Choose what appears at the event website address. The address cannot be renamed here.
records.when: Choose your public website before End.

options.label: Built-in event page
options.means: Show the page configured in these tabs.

options.label: Your own website
options.means: Show an uploaded static website; requires an upload.

effects: Switching modes retains both built-in content and website uploads. Built-in edits still save while a custom site is shown.
Uploading a zip publishes immediately. Earlier uploads are listed, but an older version cannot be made live again; upload it again instead. Mode changes and publishing stop after End.
limits: Zip limit is set by the server and appears in CURRENT SETTINGS as Website zip upload limit. Include index.html at the top level.

records.label: Sign-up
records.explains: Control approval for people joining with the shared join link. Public applications always require review.
records.when: Decide how to admit new people.
effects: Turning link approval off offers a choice to leave pending link sign-ups waiting or approve them now. It does not automatically approve public applicants.

records.label: Question
records.explains: Ask Required or optional registration questions; required answers must be supplied to register.
records.when: Collect details from new sign-ups.
effects: Save questions applies the edited list. Location, age range and gender are separate optional profile fields.
limits: Up to 8 questions. Question: 1–160 characters. Answer: up to 500.

records.label: Let people apply without your join link
records.explains: Enable public applications separately from shared-link joining.
records.when: Accept people who lack your join link.
effects: An Apply button requires public applications on, directory listing on, and stage Open or Building. Turning applications off stops new applications; pending applications remain.

records.label: List this event on Find a hackathon
records.explains: Control public directory listing independently of joining and voting.
records.when: Help people find your event or hide its listing.

records.label: Team finding
records.explains: Allow participants to browse teams, request to join and invite others.
records.when: Help participants find teammates.
effects: Team links and codes work with Team finding off. Participant team operations require Open or Building.

records.label: Most people per team
records.explains: Set the team capacity.
records.when: Set or revise team capacity.
effects: Reducing capacity does not remove existing members. The editor disables this after End.

records.label: Deadline
records.explains: Set when entries and team website changes close in the event time zone.
records.when: Choose when teams must finish.
effects: At the effective deadline, complete drafts auto-submit. Incomplete settled drafts remain judgeable unless excluded.
Clearing or moving the general deadline into the future cannot reopen Closed, Judging or Results. Return to Building, or grant an individual extension where applicable. Ended blocks deadline changes.
Entry reminders apply only in Open, Building or Closed, to teams without submitted entries; taken-down teams and events are excluded.

records.label: What teams hand in
records.explains: Choose a preset and adjust summary and evidence requirements in Draft, Open or Building.
records.when: Set hand-in rules in Draft, Open or Building.

options.label: Video or website
options.means: Require video or a published team website, at least one. Code is Off; video is first after the summary.

options.label: Video, website and code link
options.means: Require all three; website is first after the summary.

effects: Presets require the summary except audience. Track is ignored without tracks. Description and screenshot are optional.
Editing lines may show Custom. Older presets are read-only.
Stricter rules keep submitted entries submitted; drafts may become blocked. Review the impact before confirming.

records.label: Summary card
records.explains: Judges see this card first. Project name is always required. Other summary rows can be Required, Optional or Off.
records.when: Set summary requirements before entries close.
effects: Track is ignored without tracks. Description is an older supported field without a current organiser row.

records.label: Project name
records.explains: The entry's name, the first row of the summary card. It is always Required: it cannot be made Optional or Off.

records.label: Problem, in one line
records.explains: The problem the project addresses.
records.when: Ask about the need before entries close.

records.label: Solution, in one line
records.explains: A short explanation of the solution, also used on the team sites list.
records.when: Ask about the solution before entries close.

records.label: Who it's for
records.explains: The people the project aims to help.
records.when: Ask who benefits before entries close.

records.label: Track
records.explains: The team’s challenge; required only when tracks exist and the rule requires it.
records.when: Require track selection before entries close.

records.label: Tools and AI
records.explains: Tags naming the tools used.
records.when: Ask about tools before entries close.
limits: Up to 10 distinct tools, each 1–30 characters.

records.label: What works today
records.explains: Describe how much of the project works.
records.when: Ask what works before entries close.

records.label: Show your work
records.explains: Set requirements for video, team website, code and screenshot.
records.when: Set evidence requirements before entries close.

options.label: One of
options.means: Supply at least one marked item.

effects: All One of rows form one group; one supplied item is enough. Off does not delete saved evidence.

records.label: Video link
records.explains: Demo video link; supported players embed, other links open externally.
records.when: Request a demo before entries close.
limits: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL, up to 500 characters.

options.label: One of
options.means: Supply at least one marked item.

records.label: Website
records.explains: The team’s published site, rather than a URL entered in the form.
records.when: Request a site before entries close.
limits: Must be live to count as present.

options.label: One of
options.means: Supply at least one marked item.

records.label: Code link
records.explains: A link to source code, such as a repository.
records.when: Request code before entries close.
limits: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL, up to 500 characters.

options.label: One of
options.means: Supply at least one marked item.

records.label: Screenshot
records.explains: An image of the project, provided by the team.
records.when: Request an image before entries close.
limits: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB and 8,000 pixels per side.

options.label: One of
options.means: Supply at least one marked item.

records.label: After the card, first
records.explains: Choose which evidence view opens after the summary card. The summary always comes first.
records.when: Set the opening view before entries close.

records.label: Reminder times
records.explains: Email teams without submitted entries before their deadline, and judges with work left before Judging closes.
records.when: Arrange deadline nudges before End.
effects: The same offsets serve both audiences. Judges also need Judging closes set. An empty list disables reminders. Changes stop after End.

Entry reminders: Open/Building/Closed only; no taken-down teams/events. Judge reminders: Judging, unlocked, future Judging closes, dedicated judge membership and work left; organiser judges are excluded.
limits: Up to 5 distinct offsets, each 15 minutes–14 days before. Defaults: 1 day and 1 hour.

records.label: Judging closes
records.explains: Set the reminder time and fixed schedule row for judging.
records.when: Time your judge reminders.
effects: This time does not stop scoring or lock judging. Clear it to stop judge reminders tied to that time. Stage and judging lock control scoring.
Judge reminders require Judging, unlocked judging, a future close and dedicated judges with work left; organiser judges are excluded.

records.label: Rubric
records.explains: Set event-wide criteria, readable by approved participants; tracks share the rubric.
records.when: Set or revise criteria while judging is unlocked.
effects: Criteria have Name, Description, Weight % and Max points. Defaults: Idea, Execution, Design, Demo, each 25% and 5 points. Unlock to edit, even after End; keep the fixed tie criterion.

records.label: Save rubric
records.explains: Keep criterion identities to preserve compatible scores across renaming, reordering and reweighting.
records.when: Save changes while judging is unlocked.
effects: Removing a scored criterion, or lowering Max points below marks judges already gave, asks you to confirm first. Removal deletes that criterion’s scores; lowering deletes only marks above the new maximum. Republish to update published standings.

records.label: Mark as final
records.explains: Mark the rubric setup item as ready for the organiser checklist. This does not replace the judging lock.
records.when: Confirm your criteria are ready.
effects: The acknowledgement follows the saved rubric version. Saving a rubric in Closed automatically marks that saved version final; changes in other stages need a fresh acknowledgement.

records.label: First tie criterion
records.explains: Choose an existing rubric criterion to break equal totals. Pick a criterion leaves no first criterion.
records.when: Choose the first tie rule before the Judging stage.
effects: While the current stage is Judging, Results or Ended, the tie criterion cannot change or leave the rubric. Returning to Closed/Building permits changes if unlocked. Equal totals use the optional criterion, then judges’ pairwise preferences; organisers order remaining ties at publication.

options.label: Pick a criterion
options.means: No first tie criterion; otherwise choose a current rubric criterion.

records.label: How judges are assigned
records.explains: Control which teams judges can score. Conflicts apply in every mode.
records.when: Allocate judging work while unlocked, before End.

options.label: Automatic
options.means: Assigns balanced pairs when Judging starts; judges score assigned teams only.

options.label: Manual
options.means: Choose pairs in the grid; judges score assigned teams only.

options.label: Panel
options.means: Choose judges per track; conflicted teams remain excluded.

effects: In Automatic and Manual, a current judge’s scores count only for teams still assigned to them; removing a pair stops its scores counting without deleting them. Former judges use the teams counted when they left.
Generating again replaces assignments, never scores. Conflicts and entry eligibility still apply. Lock blocks access changes; End blocks mode changes.

records.label: How judges are assigned
records.explains: Choose judge access; see How judges are assigned.
records.when: Allocate judging work while unlocked, before End.

records.label: How teams are ranked
records.explains: Choose the average used to rank teams. Raw criterion marks are retained.
records.when: Choose how to compare scores before End.

options.label: Average, adjusted for strict and generous judges
options.means: Calculate each judge’s weighted total, normalise those totals for strict and generous judges, then average across judges.

effects: A published snapshot does not recalculate itself. Publish again to replace it.

records.label: Show on the public page
records.explains: Control public result visibility separately from ranking calculations.
records.when: Set public result details before End.

options.label: Winners only
options.means: Show global rank-one teams and track winners, including tied winners.

effects: Requires published results. Show scores and Show ranks are independent; teams see their own score. Full ranking lists all ranked teams, omitting unranked unscored/excluded teams.

After End the editor disables visibility/ranking settings. An AI app connected to Simple Hack can still switch between Full ranking and Winners only; the ranking settings stay closed. Republish separately.

records.label: People’s choice
records.explains: Let signed-in visitors vote during a chosen window. Starts and Ends use the event time zone.
records.when: Arrange a public vote before End.

options.label: Approved event members
options.means: Approved members, including organisers and judges.

effects: Gallery must be open. Voting is unavailable in Draft and Ended. People cannot vote for their own team and can change their chosen team.
Restricting eligibility asks to permanently remove newly ineligible votes. Turning voting off or changing the window does not itself delete all votes.
limits: Both opening and closing times are required when enabled; closing must follow opening.

records.label: Organiser details
records.explains: Edit organiser identity, contact and planning details.
records.when: Set or correct organiser details.

records.label: Organisers
records.explains: Create invitation makes a link for one co-organiser; copy and send it, then they open it and accept. Co-organisers have full event control, including deletion. The creator cannot be removed.
records.when: Add or remove organising help before End.
effects: An invitation works for 7 days and is used up when someone accepts it. There is one invitation at a time: creating a new one replaces the old link. Existing event members cannot use it to switch roles. Revoke invitation stops an unused link working. Creator departure requires handover.
Remove co-organiser permanently deletes that organiser’s scores. Voluntary leaving instead preserves scores that remain eligible.

records.label: Links
records.explains: Manage shared participant and judge invitations. Team links are separate.
records.when: Invite people before joining closes.

records.label: Join link
records.explains: Copy the participant joining link or make a New link.
records.when: Invite people or replace a link before End.
effects: New link invalidates the old invitation; existing members stay. Joining needs Open or Building. No rotation after End.

records.label: Judge link
records.explains: Copy the judge invitation or make a New link.
records.when: Invite judges or replace a link before End.
effects: New link invalidates the old invitation; existing judges stay. No joining in Results or Ended, role switching, or rotation after End.

records.label: Notifications
records.explains: Notify a webhook about event website data and uploads; participant emails and reminders are separate.
records.when: Pass website activity to another service.

options.label: A visitor saves something
options.means: Notify on a new saved record.

options.label: A visitor changes something they saved

effects: Set the receiver URL and optional label, storage filter and authentication header. Creation depends on website notification allowances.
Deliveries shows history. Send test checks the receiver. Pause stops delivery; Resume restarts it. States include Active, Paused, Suspended after failures, Waiting for check and Expired.

Copy the one-time signing secret. Rotation keeps the previous secret valid for 24 hours. Remove stops delivery. Connected-app subscriptions offer Pause, Resume and Remove, but no Send test or Rotate secret. Organiser-website delivery stops after End; new subscriptions require the website write window.

records.label: Leave event
records.explains: Leave organiser membership and lose management access. Other organisers can continue.
records.when: Step away from organising before End.
effects: Nobody can leave after End. The creator must hand over; a last organiser must end or delete the event to leave.

records.label: Hand over and leave
records.explains: Choose another organiser as successor when the creator leaves. Handover transfers creator responsibility.
records.when: Pass ownership on when leaving before End.
effects: With no successor, the last organiser must choose End event and leave or permanent deletion.

records.label: Delete event
records.explains: Any organiser, including a co-organiser, can permanently delete the event and its public page. There is no undo.
records.when: Erase an unused or unwanted event.
effects: Removes memberships, team sites, entries, scores, votes and results. Available after End too. Type the event address name to confirm when ended or participants or judges exist.

records.label: People
records.explains: Review event membership and pending applications. Show filters the membership list.
records.when: Check membership and waiting applicants.

records.label: Applications
records.explains: Approve or reject pending applications. Only pending decisions can be changed.
records.when: Review pending applicants before End.

options.label: Any
options.means: Do not filter this profile field.

effects: Decisions send app and email notices. Rejection cannot be edited; the applicant can leave and apply again while applications are open.
Age range and Country filter optional profile data.

records.label: Age range
records.explains: Filter pending applications by their optional reported age range.
records.when: Find applicants in an age range.

records.label: Remove from event
records.explains: Remove a participant or judge; manage organisers in Organisers settings.
records.when: Remove someone’s access before End.
effects: Membership and publishing access are removed. A removed judge’s eligible scores are preserved as former-judge scores.

Rotates the old team’s code and revokes stale publishing keys. An emptied team can be deleted with its entry. A frozen empty team stays without self-leave kept-team protection and can disappear from judging/results.

records.label: Turn off publishing key
records.explains: Revoke this person’s publishing credential immediately. This does not remove their membership.
records.when: Stop publishing with someone’s current key.
effects: They must create another key themselves to publish again.

records.label: Judges
records.explains: Invite dedicated judges with the judge link; organisers can also use the judge interface.
records.when: Recruit people to assess entries.

records.label: Teams
records.explains: Browse teams, sizes, tracks and admission status. Open one for its membership, entry, joining and management controls.
records.when: Check team membership and progress.

records.label: Not on a team
records.explains: Approved participants without a team can be placed individually or using Fill teams.
records.when: Fill teams in Open or Building.
effects: Fill teams works with Team finding off, in Open or Building. It skips locked teams and previews existing and new team placements before applying.
limits: People per team: 1–event maximum; default is the smaller of 4 and that maximum.

records.label: Team
records.explains: Open a team to inspect Members, Messages, Joining, Entry & site and the Danger zone.
records.when: Inspect or manage one team.
effects: Team name can be changed separately from membership and entry.

records.label: Members
records.explains: Add someone, move a participant, take them off the team or choose team admins.
records.when: Adjust membership or admins before End.
effects: Placement needs approval and capacity. Organisers can bypass ordinary admission locks, but cannot refill kept empty teams.
Organiser changes stop after End; participant stage and deadline limits are separate.

records.label: Lock team
records.explains: Stop admission through team links, codes, requests and invitations.
records.when: Close or reopen team admission before End.
effects: Clears outstanding requests and invitations; Fill teams skips the team. Organiser placement can override an ordinary lock subject to capacity.
This is separate from the entry deadline and does not itself freeze submission. Kept empty teams cannot be unlocked or refilled.

records.label: Team link
records.explains: Members of the event can join directly through a team link when eligible.
records.when: Share or replace team access before End.
effects: New link invalidates the old team link and code; current members remain. Team finding can be off, but team locks and participant stage limits still apply.

records.label: Delete this team
records.explains: Permanently remove the team, its entry and its site. Members remain in the event without a team.
records.when: Erase a team and its work before End.
effects: Deletion permanently removes scores, votes and other team-owned judging records too.
There is no undo. This differs from a kept empty team after final-member departure: that record can retain entry, site and scores.
Unavailable after End.

records.label: Message team
records.explains: Send a private message to one team or Message selected teams. This is separate from a public announcement.
records.when: Contact teams privately before End.
effects: Notifies current team recipients and keeps team message history. No sends after End.
limits: Message: 1–1,000 characters. Select 1–25 teams. At most 50 team-message rows per event per rolling hour; each recipient team counts as one row.

records.label: Entries
records.explains: Review hand-ins and missing fields; submitted or settled incomplete entries are judgeable unless excluded.
records.when: Check hand-ins and missing items.

records.label: Entry & site
records.explains: Inspect summary, evidence, missing items and site; missing items do not exclude settled entries.
records.when: Inspect one team’s work.

records.label: Exclude from judging
records.explains: Exclude an entry without deleting it or taking its website down. Include in judging reverses this.
records.when: Disqualify an entry or restore its eligibility.
effects: Entry and scores remain stored; exclusion removes judging eligibility. Restoring inclusion restores eligibility subject to the other rules.
The server allows exclusion and restoration after End; republish to update the published snapshot.

records.label: More time until
records.explains: Give one team more time, or clear its extension.
records.when: Give a team extra time or clear an unused extension.
effects: An extension extends an existing general deadline; it does not shorten it or create a standalone deadline. Clearing it restores the general deadline, which may have passed.
Judging, Results and Ended freeze writes even with a future extension. A reopened unsubmitted settled draft can be reconsidered at its later deadline.
Organisers cannot grant or clear extensions after End.
limits: A general deadline must exist. The extension must be later than it.

records.label: Take this site down
records.explains: Replace the team website with a notice. Optionally give a reason shown to the team.
records.when: Remove an unsuitable site from public view.
effects: Put back reverses an organiser takedown. An organiser cannot restore a platform takedown. This is separate from excluding an entry from judging.
Taking down a site also blocks the team’s entry edits and publishing and removes it from gallery and voting choices. Taking down or putting back is unavailable after End.

records.label: Announcements
records.explains: Post Title and Message publicly and in participants’ app; optionally email them on creation.
records.when: Share event news publicly before End.
effects: Editing does not resend email. Deleting removes the announcement. No posting, editing or deletion after End.

records.label: Message
records.explains: After a stage change, an optional announcement can tell participants what changed. The suggested title and message are editable.
records.when: Explain a stage change before End.
effects: Email is optional on creation; later editing never emails again. Skipping the announcement does not undo the stage change.

records.label: Judging
records.explains: Manage assignments, progress, conflicts, former judges and the judging lock.
records.when: Check judging work and progress.

records.label: Assignments
records.explains: Open the Assignment grid for manual pairs and track panels. Automatic mode assigns judges by itself when Judging starts.
records.when: Set up during Entries closed; locked during Judging.
effects: Automatic mode generates assignments at the move to Judging (judges only, not organisers). It replaces pairs, never deletes scores and respects conflicts.
In Automatic and Manual, a current judge’s scores for a team stop counting when their pair is removed. Reassigning restores otherwise eligible scores; published snapshots need republishing.
Manual pairs require Manual mode; track panels use Panel mode. Judging, Lock and End block changes; the grid is read-only then.

records.label: Progress
records.explains: Review team and judge scoring coverage and work remaining. Only teams with a judgeable entry enter the judging pool.
records.when: Check score coverage before publication.

records.label: Judges who know a team
records.explains: Record a judge/team conflict to prevent that judge scoring that team in every assignment mode.
records.when: Prevent biased scores while unlocked, before End.
effects: Previous scores remain stored but are excluded from totals and coverage. Removing the conflict restores eligibility. A track-panel membership can remain while a conflicted team is excluded.

records.label: Former judges
records.explains: Scores from judges who leave keep counting when otherwise eligible. Delete scores is an explicit removal.
records.when: Review or delete departed judges’ scores before End.
effects: Unlock judging before deleting. Deletion is permanent and requires confirmation. Published snapshots change only after republishing.

records.label: Lock judging
records.explains: Freeze scoring, rubric changes and assignments. Unlock requires a reason.
records.when: Freeze judging inputs or unlock for corrections.
effects: Scoring also requires Closed or Judging. Unlocking does not change the stage. Results locks judging; moving back to Judging keeps that lock. The server allows unlocking after End, but scoring stays closed.

records.label: Results
records.explains: Preview current standings, resolve tied places, publish and download results. The preview can differ from the last published snapshot.
records.when: Prepare or update results publication.

records.label: Save order and publish
records.explains: Resolve tied places by giving a complete order for each tied group, then publish that order.
records.when: Set the final order when teams share a place.
effects: Overrides apply to whole tied groups; they cannot move arbitrary untied teams.

records.label: Publish results
records.explains: Publish a results snapshot, replacing any previous one. There is no unpublish action.
records.when: Release or update official standings.
effects: The screen requires locked judging. Server publishing from Closed or Judging moves to Results and locks; Draft, Open and Building are rejected.
Republish after End without reopening. Score or setting changes never update a published snapshot automatically.

records.label: Downloads
records.explains: Download event records and team websites.
records.when: Keep records or sites, including after End.
effects: Results CSV uses the published tie-resolved snapshot when available, otherwise current preview. Scores, Entries, Teams and People CSV provide their respective records. All team sites downloads an archive.

records.label: Create event
records.explains: Create a Draft event with Title, Address, Starts, Ends (optional), Time zone and organiser details.
records.when: Start planning a new event.
effects: Address is chosen at creation, not renamed through Website. Organiser details can be edited later.
limits: Address: 3–39 lowercase letters, digits or single hyphens, with no leading or trailing hyphen; available and not reserved.
Title: 1–120. Name: 1–100. Organisation: up to 120. Purpose: 1–1,000 characters. Expected participants: 1–100,000. Valid email required. End cannot precede start.
Creation is subject to configurable rolling daily and active-event limits per creator: defaults are 3 creations per day and 2 active events.

records.label: Actions
records.explains: Open the row menu for available actions. Permissions and state determine its options.
records.when: Manage someone from their row.

records.label: Description
records.explains: Legacy long description: optional in current presets, with no organiser rule row.

records.label: Approve people who join with your link before they can join a team or publish
records.explains: Require approval of link sign-ups before team joining and publishing.
records.when: Review sign-ups before granting team access.

options.label: Leave them pending
options.means: Keep existing pending link sign-ups waiting while disabling approval for new link sign-ups.

options.label: Approve all now
options.means: Admit pending link sign-ups when turning approval off.

records.label: Required
records.explains: A required registration question must be answered before the person can register.

records.label: Make admin
records.explains: Give a team member admin authority. Remove as admin takes that authority away if another admin remains.
records.when: Share or change team admin duties before End.
effects: Team admins manage joining requests and team administration. They are not event organisers.

records.label: Move to another team…
records.explains: Move one approved participant to another team using its chooser.
records.when: Rebalance teams or correct a placement before End.
effects: Destination capacity applies; organiser placement can bypass an ordinary admission lock. A kept empty team cannot accept replacements.

Rotates the old team’s code and revokes stale publishing keys. An emptied team can be deleted with its entry. A frozen empty team stays without self-leave kept-team protection and can disappear from judging/results.

records.label: Take off team
records.explains: Remove someone from this team while keeping their event membership.
records.when: Let someone change teams before End.
effects: Rotates the old team’s code and revokes stale publishing keys. An emptied team can be deleted with its entry. A frozen empty team stays without self-leave kept-team protection and can disappear from judging/results.

records.label: Put on a team…
records.explains: Choose a destination for a participant without a team.
records.when: Place a participant without a team before End.

records.label: Ends
records.explains: Optional event end date and time. It does not end the event automatically.

records.label: Track name
records.explains: Name a challenge teams can choose.

records.label: Challenge
records.explains: Describe the task for this track.

records.label: Prize
records.explains: Describe this track’s prize.

records.label: Logo
records.explains: Upload or replace a sponsor logo; Remove clears it from the edited sponsor.
limits: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 128 KB.
records.when: Add or replace sponsor branding before End.

records.label: Name
records.explains: The sponsor’s public name.

records.label: Tier
records.explains: An optional sponsor tier such as Gold.

records.label: Link
records.explains: Optional sponsor website link.
limits: HTTPS, no embedded credentials, up to 500 characters.

records.label: Name
records.explains: The name judges see for a scoring criterion.

records.label: Description (optional)
records.explains: Explain how judges should interpret a criterion.

records.label: Weight %
records.explains: The criterion’s share of the weighted total.

records.label: Max points
records.explains: The highest mark a judge can award for this criterion.

records.label: Judges per team
records.explains: Target number of judges for allocation.

records.label: Your name
records.explains: Name identifying the organiser on the public page.

records.label: Organisation or community
records.explains: Optional public organiser organisation.

records.label: Contact email
records.explains: A valid contact address for event administration.
limits: Must be a valid email address.

records.label: What the event is for
records.explains: Purpose information private to organisers and Simple Hack.

records.label: Expected participants
records.explains: An estimate of event attendance.

records.label: URL
records.explains: The webhook receiver address.
limits: HTTPS, up to 2,048 bytes; no credentials or fragment. Receiver address must pass server checks.

records.label: Label (optional)
records.explains: A name to identify this notification.

records.label: Storage (optional)
records.explains: Filter the notification to a storage name; leave blank for all.
limits: Must name existing storage; blank means all. Editor: up to 100 characters.

records.label: Header name (optional)
records.explains: Optional receiver authentication header name.
limits: Authorization, or X- plus 1–62 letters, digits or hyphens. Forwarding, client-IP and platform-reserved headers are refused.

records.label: Header value
records.explains: The value sent in the optional receiver authentication header.

records.label: Reason shown to the team (optional)
records.explains: Explain why the organiser has taken a team website down.

records.label: Address
records.explains: Choose the event’s permanent address name when creating it.
limits: 3–39 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; no leading or trailing hyphen. Must be available.

records.label: Email ${emailableCount} participants
records.explains: Optionally email participants when creating an announcement. Editing later does not send another email.
records.when: Email event news when posting before End.

records.label: Leave or delete
records.explains: Choose between leaving your organiser role and permanently deleting the event.
records.when: Leave organising or erase the event.

records.label: Ask
records.explains: Ask answers questions about this event with links to where to act. It never changes anything.
records.when: Get help with this event.
effects: History stays in this browser per event and is cleared on sign-out. New chat clears this conversation and stops its reply.
Send asks a question. Stop cancels the reply, keeping partial text. Retry repeats the last question, replacing its previous answer.
limits: Daily questions reset at midnight UTC. Near the limit, questions left are shown. At the limit: You've asked [limit] questions today. The limit resets at midnight UTC.
Monthly budget message: The assistant has used this month's budget. It's back on [date]. Asking stays disabled until reset.
